## Summary

I resolved ticket T-3001 by investigating the pending trainer pod in the ml-training namespace. The issue is that the new Q3 job configuration requests 16 CPU cores, but the cluster nodes (m6i.2xlarge) only provide 8 vCPU each. Kubernetes cannot schedule the pod because no single node has sufficient capacity [cite: concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers#how-pods-with-resource-requests-are-scheduled-0]. The fix is to reduce the CPU request in the job config to fit the available node capacity (max 8 CPU per node) or add more/larger nodes to the cluster.
